title: inventory.v1.StockReserved
description: A time-limited claim on stock succeeded. Units are counted against `reserved` but still physically present and still counted in `on_hand`. Nothing has been deducted. The claim lapses at `expires_at` unless committed or released first.

reservation_id.description: Allocated by inventory before the claim is attempted, so that a retried request with the same idempotency_key resolves to this same reservation rather than making a second one.

expires_at.description: When the claim lapses. Must comfortably exceed the saga's worst-case time to reach CommitReservation, or reservations will expire mid-saga. See docs/sagas.md for the budget.
